description: WikiQA-style retrieval benchmark for the logistics SOP knowledge base. Like WikiQA (Yang et al., 2015), each question is paired with the passage(s) that answer it, and some questions deliberately have NO answer in the corpus so the zero-hallucination guardrail can be evaluated. 'relevant' lists every acceptable chunk id; an empty list marks an unanswerable question.
